name: Marker
description: What a piece of source claims to implement, read from the comment in front of it.

scenarios.title: A claim attaches to whatever statement follows it
given: a linear script whose claims sit in front of statements rather than methods
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: each claim answers at the line its comment sits on

scenarios.title: Depth is not a barrier
given: claims inside a class body and inside a method body
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: both are read, at whatever depth they sit

scenarios.title: A claim in a block comment
given: a claim on the second line of a =begin block
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: the claim answers at the line its keyword is on rather than where the block began

scenarios.title: A comment nothing follows
given: a claim at the end of a file with no code after it
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims

scenarios.title: What follows the keyword is handed back unread
given: a comment naming more than one word after the keyword
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: the whole of the line after the keyword arrives as one claim

scenarios.title: A file that is not Ruby
given: a prose file in scope carrying the keyword
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims

scenarios.title: Source the grammar cannot read
given: a Ruby file the grammar cannot parse
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: the file is named as unreadable rather than answering with the claims it recovered

scenarios.title: The path arrives absolute
given: a Ruby file named by an absolute path
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: each claim answers relative to where the run started

scenarios.title: Two keywords in one pass
given: a file carrying claims under two different keywords
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for both keywords at once
scenarios.then: each claim names the keyword it was found under

scenarios.title: A keyword with nothing after it
given: a comment carrying the keyword and nothing else
scenarios.when: the file is scanned for claims
scenarios.then: the claim arrives carrying no text rather than being dropped
